questions.question: If a vehicle using high beams comes toward you, where should you look?
questions.explanation: Look toward the right side of the road. This prevents the bright headlights from blinding you and lets you see the road well enough to stay on course until the other vehicle passes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. HOV lanes are only for buses and cars with a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: When you are in a line of traffic crossing a railroad track with no signals or gates, what should you do?

options.text: You have the right-of-way and do not need to check for trains.
You may pass slower drivers while crossing the track.
Make sure there is enough space for your vehicle to cross the tracks without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure there is enough space for your vehicle to cross the tracks without stopping.
questions.explanation: Check that you have enough room to completely cross the tracks before driving onto them. Never pass another vehicle at a railroad crossing. Always look for trains before crossing any railroad tracks.

questions.question: For drivers age 21 or older, it is illegal to drive with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of:
questions.explanation: For drivers age 21 or older, a BAC of 0.08 percent or higher is illegal. Driving under the influence of alcohol is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: What do regulatory signs do?

options.text: Are placed in every location where there is a present danger.
Tell drivers what they must or must not do.
Are diamond-shaped and yellow or green.
May warn drivers that they are approaching a school zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Tell drivers what they must or must not do.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are usually rectangular and white with black markings. They tell drivers what things they must or must not do. They may show speed limits, no passing rules, no turning rules, or other driving rules.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to continue driving in your current direction.

questions.question: A leaking exhaust system can:

options.text: Require your vehicle to have a tune-up sooner than normal.
Set grass fires on country roads.

questions.explanation: The exhaust system removes harmful gases, reduces noise, and cools hot gases from the engine. Fumes from a leaky exhaust system can cause drowsiness while driving and can be deadly in a short time.

questions.question: A fire engine is following your vehicle on a two-lane street without using emergency signals. What should you do?

options.text: Continue to drive in a normal manner.
Stop as quickly as you can.
Speed up to get out of its way.
Slow down, move as far to the right as possible, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue to drive in a normal manner.
questions.explanation: If an emergency vehicle is following you without using sirens or flashing lights, you do not need to pull over. Continue driving normally.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells drivers to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You may continue when it is safe.

questions.question: A solid white line on the right edge of the highway angles toward the center. What does this mean?

options.text: There is an intersection just ahead.
You are approaching a construction area.
You will be required to turn left just ahead.

questions.explanation: A solid line on the road edge shows where the road ends and the shoulder begins. If the line angles toward the center of the road, it means the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: If your car starts to skid, which way should you turn the steering wheel?

options.text: In the direction you want the vehicle to go.
In the opposite direction of the skid.
In any direction. It doesn't matter.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the direction you want the vehicle to go.
questions.explanation: Turn the steering wheel in the direction you want the vehicle to go. Once the vehicle starts to straighten out, turn the wheel back the other way.

questions.question: When should you leave extra space between your car and the car in front of you?
questions.explanation: Leave extra space in front of your vehicle on an uphill slope. If the car ahead rolls backward when traffic starts moving, you will have more room to avoid a collision.

questions.question: A red flashing traffic light means the same thing as a:
questions.explanation: A red flashing traffic light means the same as a stop sign. Come to a complete stop and then go when it is safe.

questions.question: How far can a fully loaded tractor-trailer traveling at 55 mph take to stop?
questions.explanation: Large trucks need much longer to stop than cars at the same speed. A fully loaded tractor-trailer can take almost 400 feet to stop when traveling at 55 mph.

questions.question: What does a single broken yellow line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is allowed when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is allowed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is allowed when safe.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken yellow line means drivers can pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: Does drinking coffee reduce alcohol in your blood?

options.text: No, it has no effect on blood alcohol.

questions.correctAnswerText: No, it has no effect on blood alcohol.
questions.explanation: Coffee will not lower your blood alcohol level. It may help you stay awake, but it cannot make you sober or change your blood alcohol level.

questions.question: What is a speed limit?

options.text: The maximum or minimum legal speed under dangerous conditions.
The maximum or minimum legal speed under ideal conditions.
The suggested speed under ideal conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum or minimum legal speed under ideal conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit is the legal maximum or minimum speed you can drive under ideal conditions. You can drive slower, but driving faster is illegal. Drive slower in school zones, work zones, or bad weather.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: When turning left from a multilane, one-way street, which lane should you start from?
questions.explanation: Start a left turn from the left lane on multilane streets and highways.

questions.question: Why should drivers be extra alert to motorcyclists, bicyclists, and pedestrians?

options.text: They are hard to see in traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are hard to see in traffic.
questions.explanation: Many crashes happen because drivers did not see motorcycles, bicycles, or pedestrians even though they were looking. These are smaller and harder to spot than cars. They move fast and have less noticeable lights. Stay alert for these smaller road users to avoid collisions.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a steady yellow arrow at a traffic signal?

options.text: Merge into the lane that the arrow points to.
Slow down and stop if you can do so safely.
Turn left after you let oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass.
You have the right-of-way and oncoming traffic must stop for you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and stop if you can do so safely.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow arrow means a red arrow is coming next. Stop unless you are already in the intersection.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm and hand downward, they are signaling that they will stop. Adjust your driving if you are following a driver using this signal.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a steady green arrow at a traffic signal?

options.text: Merge into the lane that the arrow points to.
Slow down and stop if you can do so safely.
Turn in the direction of the arrow after letting traffic and pedestrians already in the intersection pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn in the direction of the arrow after letting traffic and pedestrians already in the intersection pass.
questions.explanation: A green arrow tells you that you can turn in that direction. You must be in the correct lane. Always let vehicles and pedestrians already in the intersection go first.

questions.question: Blood alcohol content (BAC) depends on all of the following except:

options.text: How much time passes between drinks.

questions.explanation: BAC depends on how much you drink, the time between drinks, and your weight. Physical fitness does not affect BAC.

questions.question: You must not drive faster than:

options.text: A speed that is reasonable and safe.
A speed that is safe for current conditions.

questions.explanation: You must follow the speed limit and drive at a speed that is reasonable and safe for the area, traffic, pedestrians, weather, road condition, and light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes very slippery when wet.

questions.question: What should you do at an intersection with a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Stop and wait for the light to change.
Make a U-turn because the intersection is closed.
Get ready to stop; the light is about to turn red.

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means proceed slowly and with caution. Look both ways before going through.

questions.question: If you move, how long do you have to tell the Driver License Bureau your new address?
questions.explanation: You must notify the Driver License Bureau within 10 days of any address change. You can get forms from county treasurers, highway patrol troopers, driver license examiners, or online.

questions.question: What does a speed restriction sign show?

options.text: You can ignore it in rain, snow, or ice.
It is blue with black letters.
It shows a recommended speed for a curve or turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: It shows a recommended speed for a curve or turn.
questions.explanation: Speed signs on curves and turns show a recommended speed. You should follow this speed even in good weather. In rain, snow, or ice, drive even slower than the recommended speed.

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: Other drivers can follow motorcycles closely.
A motorcycle with two riders is more balanced than one with one rider.
You must move completely into the left lane when passing a motorcycle.
Motorcycle brake lights turn on whenever the rider slows down.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must move completely into the left lane when passing a motorcycle.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are entitled to use a full lane. Make sure your entire vehicle is in the left lane before passing a motorcycle.
